## Self-review checklist (every box, or the PR does not open)

- [ ] No secrets anywhere in the diff. This repo holds only public configuration; no private name or value appears.
- [ ] No personal data in the diff: no screenshots, check-ins, plans, test data. `icon.png` is the only image.
- [ ] No em dashes in code, comments, docs, or UI text.
- [ ] Minimal disclosure: no identity, no security process, no revealing error or message text on any public surface (repo, screens, errors, emails). `ci.yml`'s word check passes.
- [ ] Every write goes through a backend call with the session; the app never writes to storage directly.
- [ ] A test check-in was run through the changed screens, and the result is written below.
- [ ] Docs updated where they live, or "no doc change needed" is stated below.
- [ ] `README.md` and `CLAUDE.md` in this repo still true.
